messages:
maria: Heads-up — we got a couple of support tickets showing silent v1->v2 switches (no banner) and the console telemetry isn't making it obvious which routing path was used. Can we sketch a short "telemetry cookbook" for the console and runbooks?
kenji: +1 on cookbook. Main pain: we don't have a single signal that ties request -> route decision -> quota bucket -> client-visible version. Need a traceable path id.
sarah: Agree. Minimal signals: route_decision (v1|v2|variant), route_reason (pin|grace|fallback|autoswitch), quota_bucket, sampling_cohort. If we tag logs with request_route_id we can join across traces/dashboards.
tim: For console UX, show per-tenant last-100 decisions histogram + a sticky-routing percentage. Add a toggle to surface only routes where route_reason != pin.
julie: Also important: quota smoothing metric during grace window so customers see expected delta when we flip. I suggest a 1h rolling mean + a 95th percentile spike metric.
kenji: Implementation idea: emit an event per decision with fields: request_route_id, route, route_reason, model_variant, quota_bucket, sampling_cohort, client_version. Use sampling_cohort for reduced cardinality.
alex: Sample payload (we can ingest into metrics pipeline):
```
{
  "request_route_id": "r_abc123",
  "route": "v2",
  "route_reason": "autoswitch",
  "model_variant": "v2-quant",
  "quota_bucket": "standard",
  "sampling_cohort": "A",
  "client_version": "sdk-0.9.2"
}
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed routing-change-probe to eng-platform at 2024-11-07T12:04:00Z :rocket: 
maria: For dashboards: one panel that groups by sampling_cohort and route_reason, shows failure rate and median latency. Another panel for quota_delta_preview: predicted token spend delta if tenant is moved from v1->v2.
kenji: Telemetry ingest: if we tag metrics with sampling_cohort, then we can keep high-fidelity traces for cohort A and aggregate for others. Sampling rates: A=100%, B=10%, C=1% by default.
sarah: We should also emit a synthetic "migration-preview" metric that estimates cost delta using model profile lookup. That helps Sales/CS to explain billing changes early.
tim: UX copy: "Your requests are currently routed X% to v2 (autoswitch). Toggle 'Show migration preview' to see estimated cost/latency differences." Keep it small and link to the runbook.
julie: Runbook ops checklist: 1) enable cohort A trace for 1h, 2) validate route_decision histogram, 3) check quota_delta_preview < threshold, 4) flip console badge to "migration visible". Assign owners.
alex: Slight concern: high-cardinality tags (tenant_id + model_variant) will blow up metrics. We should roll up by quota_bucket + sampling_cohort and only keep trace-level spans with request_route_id.
kenji: Implementation note for runtime: add a lightweight header X-Route-Decisions: r_abc123;route=v2;reason=autoswitch;cohort=A. That lets downstream infra correlate without heavy payload.
maria: Action items: kenji to add event schema + header (ETA 2 days), sarah to update dashboard templates (ETA 3 days), tim to draft console copy & toggle UX (ETA 2 days), julie to add runbook steps to ops repo (ETA 1 day).
ops-bot: reminder: weekly-metrics-pipeline job will pick up new fields only after schema migration. Patch scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC.
alex: One more: add alert when sticky-routing percentage drops by >20% in 15m window — indicates unexpected churn.
maria: Love it. If we get the cookbook as a short doc + dashboard templates we can include it in the deprecation console flow. I'll draft the doc and ping owners. :+1: 
kenji: I'll open the PR for the header + event emitter and link the sampling config.
sarah: I'll clone the dashboard and put a note about sampling cohorts.
julie: I'll add the runbook entry and a rollback checklist.
maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene tomorrow after PRs land.
